jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE landscape 16:9 illustration for a direct sequel in this exact existing Japanese picture-book series, artwork only. Input 1 is the canonical squirrel identity and watercolor/colored-pencil style reference. Input 2 fixes the glowing golden-green forest depth and scale. Match the SAME squirrel: orange-brown rounded little body, cream muzzle and belly, tiny black oval eyes, rosy cheeks, short forehead stripes, huge curled striped tail, red neckerchief only. Warm richly textured watercolor with fine colored pencil strokes on paper, gentle natural outlines, luminous dappled sunlight, detailed giant mossy trees and daisies. Scene 01: a newly fashionable LARGE WICKER BACK BASKET is being used in the woodland clearing. Establish a wide scene: a friendly large round brown bear with green neckerchief stands right of center comfortably carrying a tall cylindrical golden wicker back basket containing acorns. A deer and white rabbit with blue scarf carry similar large baskets in the background. In left foreground, the canonical small squirrel, unburdened, watches with curiosity. His full body occupies about 30% image height; bear about 45%. Show that the big basket works well for the big bear. The basket's recognizable shape: cylindrical woven honey-brown wicker, broad circular rim, two plain tan shoulder straps, no lid. No carts, vehicles, modern objects or festival decorations. No text, letters, labels, speech bubbles, borders or watermarks. Keep bottom 14% mainly grassy path, with important paws above that area because an editable caption will be placed below the art. Vary the composition naturally from the reference; preserve character identity and series palette.
